recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Further changes to timing relationship semantics should be considered under later issues such as FHIR-26696, not as a missing application of FHIR-11550.
issue_request: FHIR-11550 was a Published CDS change request resolved Persuasive with Modification. It requested combining relatedAction.relationship and relatedAction.anchor, including GuidanceResponse, into the nine relationship codes before-start, before, before-end, concurrent-with-start, concurrent, concurrent-with-end, after-start, after, and after-end.
initial_application: SVN #10082, imported as git commit 6035db0d17e6050e99907530dc154276673675f6, removed ActionRelationshipAnchor/action-relationship-anchor and relatedAction.anchor from PlanDefinition and GuidanceResponse spreadsheets and expanded ActionRelationshipType to the requested combined code list. FHIR-12301 then removed GuidanceResponse action elements one day later, so GuidanceResponse no longer has a current relatedAction anchor surface.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists PlanDefinition, GuidanceResponse, and RequestOrchestration as active resources. Current PlanDefinition and RequestOrchestration relatedAction.relationship elements use the combined ActionRelationshipType values, and the current ActionRelationshipType CodeSystem contains the requested before/concurrent/after codes with start/end variants. Later Published issue FHIR-26696 added hierarchy, concept maps, and optional endRelationship elements for the same timing relationship family without reintroducing the old anchor element.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source has no relatedAction.anchor, relationshipAnchor, action-relationship-anchor, or ActionRelationshipAnchor remnants in build-scope source, and the authoritative PlanDefinition/RequestOrchestration sources already carry the combined code model.

related_jiras.note: Removed GuidanceResponse action elements shortly after the FHIR-11550 application, eliminating the GuidanceResponse relatedAction anchor surface from the current resource.
Clarified the same ActionRelationshipType code family by adding hierarchy, concept maps, and optional endRelationship elements while preserving the combined codes.
Renamed RequestGroup to RequestOrchestration, which explains the current action orchestration surface checked alongside PlanDefinition.
